title: Pair Up
seo: Play Pair Up, a logic puzzle with matching pieces, portals and clever obstacles. Explore colorful worlds, solve tricky boards and beat your best score!
about:
One clever move can change the whole board. In Pair Up, slide matching pieces together and clear the targets to solve each puzzle.

Explore colorful worlds, from desert temples and frozen portals to volcanoes and islands in the sky. Use pipes, teleporters, keys, locks and bombs, and watch how gravity changes your next move.

Earn bonus points for spare moves and time. Replay levels to improve your personal best, try a different approach with Undo, or restart when you need a fresh look. Play in portrait or landscape, with optional zoom controls for smaller screens.
short: Match pieces, master tricky boards and beat your best score!
how:
Clear all target pieces. The level goals show which types to remove and how many remain.

Drag a movable piece horizontally or vertically to bring matching pieces together. Use pipes and teleporters, match keys to locks, and plan around gravity and hazardous tiles.

On mobile, enable zoom mode to pinch and pan. Tap a piece, then tap a destination in the same row or column.

Use Undo or Restart to try another approach. Finish with spare moves and time to earn bonus points and improve your best score.
